How It Works

Cleared in Three Simple Steps

No skips to fill, no trips to the tip, no heavy lifting. We handle the whole job from first call to final sweep.

STEP 01

Tell Us What Needs Removed

Call or WhatsApp us on 07758 914787 — send a photo of the waste and we’ll know exactly what’s involved.

STEP 02

Receive Your Quote

You’ll get a clear, honest price with no obligation. If a quote elsewhere seems too good to be true, ask yourself — is my waste being fly-tipped?

STEP 03

We Clear It Away

Our crew arrives, loads everything and sweeps up behind them. Your waste is disposed of legally by a SEPA registered carrier.

About Corrimac

Built on Friendship. Driven by Professionalism.

Corrimac Waste Solutions was established in 2021 by childhood friends Gary and Willie. A strong friendship, built over a lifetime, became the foundation of a business with one simple aim — to deliver a first-class waste uplift service that Scotland can rely on.

Every job is different, so every service is tailored to the individual customer. Whether it’s a single item uplift or a full house clearance, Gary, Willie and the team bring the same care, honesty and professionalism to every door they knock on.

Tailored to YouServices shaped around your property, your timescale and your requirements.
A Local Team That CaresA Scottish company through and through — our word is our reputation.

Responsible Disposal

Waste Removed. Responsibly Handled.

When you hand your waste to Corrimac, you can rest assured your items are being professionally and legally disposed of — never fly-tipped. Our quotes might not always be the cheapest, and that’s because doing the job properly matters.

As a SEPA registered waste carrier, we operate to the standards Scotland’s environment deserves — so the countryside, streets and communities we serve stay tidy for everyone.

  • SEPA registered waste carrier — registration WCR/R/3015980
  • Fully licensed and insured company you can trust
  • Waste taken to legitimate, authorised disposal facilities
  • Proof of proper disposal available for landlords, agents & solicitors
